projects.title: Star Wars Wiki Compose
projects.shortDescription: My first project shipped to the world: Star Wars data from external APIs plus keyword image search, on Google Play.
projects.fullDescription: My first big project, and the first one I put in front of strangers. It pulls Star Wars data from public APIs and adds keyword image search on top, so a character page arrives with pictures instead of a blank slot. The UI is Jetpack Compose end to end; data comes through Apollo, so the schema drives the models rather than hand-written DTOs. Published on the Play Store under the diether18 developer account.

projects.title: Filebrowser API
projects.shortDescription: A private project born from needing a container to manage files for another service. Spring and Kotlin.
projects.fullDescription: A private project born from needing a container to manage files for another service — a small Spring Boot service in Kotlin, packaged as a Docker container, exposing a minimal file-management API.

projects.title: Database Scheduler Executor
projects.shortDescription: Kotlin app that runs SQLite statements on a schedule from CRON expressions, configured in a properties file.
projects.fullDescription: A Kotlin app that executes SQLite statements on a schedule driven by CRON expressions, with the schedule and queries configured entirely through a properties file — no code changes needed to add a new scheduled job.

projects.title: Tuya Key Extractor KT
projects.shortDescription: Local key extractor for Tuya devices. Written because I needed it to run somewhere other than Windows.
projects.fullDescription: A local key extractor for Tuya smart-home devices, written because I needed it to run somewhere other than Windows — the JVM is the most universal engine for that, so a small Kotlin/JVM tool it is.
